summary: Restore foundational shared gameplay semantics that are already active in the maintained v0.7.2 rules and current canonical objects but were omitted from the consolidated structured current-game authority.
authorityPrinciple: game-data/current-game.json remains the complete current gameplay authority. Historical v0.6 material may corroborate a rule but does not control this restoration.

battle: ordinary battle roll and battle-total calculation
Advantage and Disadvantage stacking, cancellation, and die selection
ordered Aftermath procedure and battle-card clearing
turn: Draw Pile and Discard Pile recycling
cardRules: shared golden rules and partial-resolution defaults

regressionPolicy.requirement: Loading current-game authority must fail when a required shared baseline rule is absent or when live canonical vocabulary depends on an undeclared shared rule.
regressionPolicy.purpose: Prevent future consolidation or materialization work from silently dropping semantics that canonical objects depend on.

publicationDependencyPolicy: Register restored shared mechanics at granular semantic IDs so teaching and technical surfaces can depend on the exact authority they express; retain broad core roots for coarse grouping and compatibility rather than as the default dependency when a narrower ID exists.
